body.statement: For every fixed \(\alpha\in(0,1/2)\), \(c_\alpha<\infty\). Every certified rational multiplier \(z_B\) therefore satisfies \(z_B\le c_\alpha q_\alpha(M)\), with no dimension-dependent remainder.
body.justification: This quantile comparison prevents the finite rational calibration required by certification from introducing a hidden multiplicity divergence.
body.gap: ChernozhukovChetverikovKato2015 supplies Gaussian-max comparison and anti-concentration, while the uniform ratio for an outward-rounded Bonferroni multiplier is not stated there.
body.consumer: Software can use a rationally certified multiplier while retaining a dimension-uniform efficiency comparison.
